helpIntro: Caltech GPA is total grade credits divided by GPA-bearing units. Letter grades use Caltech’s published credit table, including plus/minus grades.
helpNote: P/F courses are excluded from GPA. A letter-grade F counts its units at zero credits, and repeated attempts remain in the GPA. The target-GPA tool is disabled because Caltech rounds grade credits course by course.
helpExample: A 9-unit A+ earns 39 credits and a 9-unit A- earns 33; 72 credits ÷ 18 units = 4.000.
